ice-sell.title: Stored goods and ice sold where a bid stands: stored null matter, methane and ice first, then the ice fields
ice-sell.note: Every route here is gated: a drain or carry opens only on stored ice and a fresh bid (requires.stored, requires.bid); a mine route only on a deep water-ice order at Central Nexus (300 units at its best price) and with an Ice Harvester I fitted. A drain needs no harvester. Stored ice is sold before new ice is mined.

reserve-prism.title: Gather what the reserve is short of: carbon first, then iron, Prism Scatter first
reserve-prism.note: Standing work into storage, nothing sold (orders ENT-019: silicon and carbon first, then iron). Needs the Mining Laser I. Silicon: no field we read holds it (Nexus Prime Material Harvesters reads 0 to 2 all day). Carbon: Acubens Belt, one ship, floor 60, into Node Beta. Iron: Ironhollow Fading Signal (beyond the border, into The Experiment, 5 ships) and Schedar Belt (beyond the border, into Node Beta, a one-ship test) first, then the shared fields: Prism Scatter (65% iron of what it gave up), Hamal (51%), Acubens Shadow Pocket, each closed at its floor.

reserve-hamal.title: Gather what the reserve is short of: carbon first, then iron, Hamal Crystal Bloom first
reserve-hamal.note: As reserve-prism with Hamal Crystal Bloom first, so the division is spread over two iron fields. Needs the Mining Laser I.
